payload.recallText: Joe asked his sister well what do you think about that as he was reading a letter he had just opened up after retrieving the mail. Joe would not give his sister a straight answer as she was curious if it was bad news or good news. She asked Joe if it had anything to do with their father's business or not. She then started to ask if it had to do with his position within his current ball team in which he helped them win the revious year's pennant. It was at that moment Joe accidentally knocked into Ms. Masdon as she walked in the room with some flowers. Joe responded you are out of here!
